concept: One concept CRM for a made-up landscaping firm (Hollowbeck Landscapes), designed as a real interface and shot three ways on graphite. Whole and turned away: every job on one board, one ice-blue card. Flat and close: that card lifted between Quoted and Booked. Square on: the same job's record, enquiry to booking, under the call to action. Graphite, a paper-white interface and one ice blue.
